title: Home Depot Bulk Inventory by ZIP
description: Enter Home Depot Internet IDs, product URLs, or Store SKUs and US ZIP codes. Inspect useful rows, failures and store coverage in the returned matrix.

products.title: Internet IDs, Store SKUs, or URLs
products.description: Use Internet IDs, product URLs, or Store SKUs. Prefix a Store SKU with sku: to make the identifier type explicit. At the FREE tier checked on 2 October 2026: $0.005 once after a valid session plus $0.003 per successful matrix row. Failed rows have no inventory-result charge; a start event can still apply. Live pricing is authoritative.

zipCodes.title: US ZIP codes
zipCodes.description: Five-digit US ZIP codes to resolve to nearby Home Depot stores. Cost scales with the matrix: products times ZIPs times storesPerZip. Malformed ZIPs are rejected by input validation before anything runs or bills.

storesPerZip.title: Nearby stores per ZIP
storesPerZip.description: Number of nearby Home Depot stores checked for each ZIP.

maxMatrixRows.title: Maximum product × store rows
maxMatrixRows.description: Maximum requested product x store rows. Inputs exceeding this matrix size are rejected before source collection. This limits potential inventory-result events; it is not a cap on compute or proxy usage. Set the run maximum total charge separately.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: US residential proxy is enabled by default and was used for the bounded owner verification. Source access can remain intermittent; inspect failures and actual useful output. Failed rows have no inventory-result charge, but a start event can still apply.
